يبتكر (form VIII)
# يَبْتَكِرُ (yabtakiru) /jab.ta.ki.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِبْتَكَرَ (ibtakara)
# يُبْتَكَرُ (yubtakaru) /jub.ta.ka.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَكَرَ (ibtakara)
# يَبْتَكِرَ (yabtakira) /jab.ta.ki.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِبْتَكَرَ (ibtakara)
# يُب
